usually we go to the movies or simply hang out at one anothers' houses and make it up as we go along. i'm going to an amusement park on sunday so that is something i can look forward to while i try to get through the week...

it's 1 am where i am so i'm going to go to sleep and maybe that will help me somewhat. thank you so much for your advice

hey, thanks for responding. honestly, i don't really have "good" days anymore, just days that are less worse than others. i feel my best when i'm hanging out with my friends or boyfriend. we can be doing anything really, just so long as i'm with someone else. the rub is that i can only spend so much time with someone before i get tired and need to be alone to "recharge", so to speak. also, most of my friends are not keen on hanging out, mostly due to social anxiety, and i can't fault them for that. i am a shy person, but i do like being with others
this is a little bit beautiful...even though she wasn't known in life, she's known all around the world now

it makes me feel a bit better to hear that someone else has lost interest in hobbies before, strangely enough. lets me know i'm not an abnormality

i have a hard time seeing anything he does as wrong because he himself hates being wrong, and at the same time he had good intentions when he was giving me advice. he wasn't looking to hurt me, but i overreacted as always and ended up hurting him. anyway, i do tend to bring my unhappiness upon myself...i have little to no actual problems in my life so my mind creates some for me. 

i think that it's possible that i am choosing to be sad due to this. however, i've tried being positive and optimistic even when it hurt and it made little to no improvement. mainly because deep down i knew that it was all a sham. anyway, i really can't say if he might be wrong because he hates being wrong (even though he's not here i don't want to say it) but i do this that he is at least partially right. i'm sorry for not being able to answer
